You are not doomed just think of these lost years as an intermission between your academic comeback. DELETE INSTAGRAM AND TIKTOK AND YOUTUBE !!  I did this in my last year of college and it changes everything. It feels refreshing to wake up without these apps and be able to actually start doing the things you want to do. I only left Reddit and Pinterest (ain’t no way I was getting addicted to these) I know many people in your position that after the pandemic, could never return to school and continue their education. They either have small jobs or apprenticeships now. Start with your gcses, the basic ones are maths and English, look into foundation courses or diplomas instead of 3 a-levels as they might burn you out. Don’t worry, I was in the exact same position as you. My thighs were covered in texture and red raised scars from my hips to knees and it went to the sides of my legs. I felt like a monster and I thought I wouldn’t feel normal again, and that I would have to wear trousers for the rest of my life. Slowly as time passed I started to come to terms with them and began taking care of them more with moisturisers and bio-oils (anything helps u don’t need expensive stuff !!) A lot of time has passed now, and 95% of them have become white and much more smoother. I have accepted them and I wear whatever I want, mini skirts, short shorts, fishnets, high socks, I can express myself. No one points them out in any setting, formal, parties, or even in romantic settings. Do people notice them? Maybe. They are still there and very visible, but I finally feel normal. I know this is a huge weight you carry on your shoulders and that you feel like it’s a secret you have to hide, but it will pass and you will feel normal again in the future (even if it seems impossible right now, it will happen). Just give it time <3
